name: King Tuscar

facts.text: King Tuscar is a level-85 hrimthursa with 300,000 health, fought beside Queen Kula as the glacier's final.
He boasts that Kula wields the finest weapon he ever made, and that his own is almost as good.
At half health he 'gains strength from Odin', hits harder and starts Mjolnir's Fury and Thor's Might blasts around him and a bleed.
When Kula dies first he screams in rage and gathers more strength.
Allakhazam lists him at level 85; he drops Tuscar's swords, axes, hammers, bows and runic shields. A 2003 visitor said he looked like an ordinary hrimthursa, not a king.
The glacier is named for him, but bot chat already notes that only Kula is talked about.

story: Tuscar was a smith before he was a king, and in his heart he is a smith still. The rime giants say he learned his craft at a forge so old that the first spearheads of the gods were quenched in its trough, and that he took away more than the trade: an oath-word of Odin's, burned into the haft of his hammer. Nobody knows if that is true. What is known is that the weapons of Tuscaran are his work, and that he wanted a queen who would carry the best of them. He gave Kula her axe and she gave him a crown that is mostly a courtesy. He minds less than the skalds think. In a fight he is all forge-heat in a cold hall. Cut him to half and the old oath answers: he calls on Odin, of all names, and the hammer-blows come down as Mjolnir's Fury and Thor's Might. Kill Kula before him and he forgets the forge entirely and fights like a widower.
legend: Raid leaders call him the anvil: he looks like any other hrimthursa until you are standing in front of him. Tanks rotate on him because his bleed stacks up. Stay out of the ring around him when he hits half, because the hammers land on everyone close. Some say kill him first so Kula's rage comes later; some say the reverse. Nobody says split them.

aggro: You came for my steel? Then have it, edge first!
Kula carries my best work. I carry the second best. You will feel both.

phases.text: All-Father! The oath you never meant to give me, I call it now!
KULA! You will burn for this in a cold forge!

death: My forge... let it go out...
slay: Another blade for the slag pile.

lairEntry: Hammer-marks score the ice around the second throne.

phases.text: Tuscar calls on Odin! Thunder rings off the ice!
King Tuscar screams for his queen!

atmosphere.realmFirstKill: Tuscar's forge is cold. The rime king has fallen.

loremasterTopic.text: A smith first and a king second. He forged Kula's axe and boasts of it still. The rime giants say an oath-word of Odin's is burned into his hammer, and that it answers him when he bleeds. Whether that is true, he calls the All-Father's name at half his strength, and the hammers come down.
